source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Prepare a detailed incident report form.
3. Define the sequence of events leading to the accident.
4. Identify the individuals involved.
5. Record eyewitness testimonies.
6. Note immediate actions taken.
7. Document any injuries, first aid, or medical attention provided.
8. Photograph and/or sketch the accident scene.
9. Use standardized forms for consistency.
10. Capture material evidence and environmental conditions.
11. Assess the safety equipment used or missing.
12. Review policies and procedures in place.
13. Conduct an immediate investigation to determine the root cause.
14. Suggest preventive measures.
15. Submit the report to the appropriate authorities.
16. Keep a copy of the report for your records.
17. Ensure confidentiality and security of sensitive information.
18. Follow up with any necessary corrective actions.
19. Update the risk assessment and safety training materials.
20. Review and update your incident reporting procedure regularly. 

Remember, accurate documentation is crucial not just
